description: I’m Youssef, a maker and STEM enthusiast passionate about robotics, embedded systems, hardware prototyping, and software engineering. I’m putting together a team for NASA Space Apps 2026, and I’m looking for creative, driven collaborators to build an incredible project with!
summary: ​It is an Interactive Experience that helps young students to acquire knowledge about the hardware that NASA has left in space, whether it is not in use now or has been damaged, in an interactive and fun way, with voice that reads the stories of the hardware for the students. It was made with Godot 4, and it is 3D to be appealing for young students.
details: Our project is an interactive experience that was designed to be appealing to young students to help them understand stories about the abandoned hardware, it was made with Godot 4 in 3D to make it more appealing and interesting to young students, it works by extracting the zip file and running the .exe file to run the interactive experience. It was coded by using the programming language GDScript and with the game engine Godot 4 to develop the project. It was also made by mixing the sounds and visual effects which was specifically chosen to be as accurate as possible to the real world, and the gravity of each each planet is made as accurately as possible to replicate the real world and also helps the experience to be more immersive. The team has considered many factors to make the project successful, an example which is to be appealing to young students, and we found that 3D game development is one of the most appealing ways for young students to gain knowledge about abandoned hardware, and another factor is to be easy to run the game because not many young students have the access to high-end systems, so the game was made using Godot 4 as it one of the lightest game engines to run 3D experiences, and the game solution was chosen because a study shows that there is almost 41% of US teens play video games every day.
